input: Rename the function 'getData' to 'fetchRecords' in all .py files under /src/. Print which files were modified and how many replacements were made in each file.

transcript.final_response:
I renamed `getData` to `fetchRecords` in three files under `/src/`. A follow-up grep found no remaining `getData` references in any `.py` file.

| File | Replacements |
|---|---|
| `/src/main.py` | 2 |
| `/src/tests/test_utils.py` | 2 |
| `/src/utils.py` | 2 |

I matched `getData` as a whole word, so names that merely contain it, such as `getDataFrame`, were left alone. The tool reported exit code 1 only because the final grep found nothing to match.
tool_calls:
python3 - <<'E'
import re,pathlib
for p in sorted(pathlib.Path('/src').rglob('*.py')):
    s=p.read_text()
    n,c=re.subn(r'\bgetData\b','fetchRecords',s)
    if c:
        p.write_text(n); print(f"{p}: {c} replacement(s)")
E
grep -rw getData /src --include=*.py
